summary: Thinking games, mind puzzles, amazing quizzes & IQ tests will twist your brain!
description:
Tricky brain puzzle game! Can you solve them all? Hundreds of tricky puzzles & adventures!  

Embark on the mind-bending journey of Riddle Test: Brain Teaser Game, a revolutionary creation by RC Games captivating 90 million players of all ages! Join hero Brian in this fusion of fun mind games for all ages and critical thinking puzzles. Brace yourself for true brain teasers and IQ challenges that aim to transform you into a riddle master.

Dive into original and creative levels that promise an anticipation-filled quest to solve brain games for all ages. Riddle Test: Brain Teaser Game offers multiple brain teaser games, tricky puzzles, and mind-bending challenges, making it the ultimate destination for aspiring riddle masters.

Solve intriguing "who is" questions and IQ tests, from determining the culprit who kill the bride to aiding a mother in finding her children. The game ensures a stimulating experience with an embedded IQ test. Enjoy the adventure with your child or partner, engaging in games for all ages for a delightful time together.

Become a clue-hunting detective, conquering smart games with picture puzzles that demand an eagle eye to crack. The included IQ test pushes your cognitive boundaries, compelling you to think outside the box for the legendary brain test.

Riddle Test: Brain Teaser Game transforms thinking games into an enjoyable brain workout for players of all ages. With hundreds of puzzles and quizzes, mysteries to crack, and challenging clues to uncover, the game elevates the joy of thinking games to new heights.

Experience the thrill of challenging, free smart games designed for all ages to work their brains out! Clues are cleverly hidden in words, photos, and questions, merging smart games with logic puzzles.

Merging smart games with logic puzzles, Riddle Test: Brain Teaser Game is a treasure trove of tricks and riddles challenging you to reach the pinnacle of being a riddle master. Victory awaits as you crack levels by answering "who is" type questions!

Prepare for the most original brain challenge with Riddle Test: Brain Teaser Game – a game dedicated to fun, developed by RC Games. Are you ready to become the brightest riddle master?

This game has a subscription-based premium feature package, it enables users to use the app without advertisements and with extra features. It's an auto-renewable subscription. The subscription period is weekly. Payment is charged to the App Store account at confirmation. Subscription is renewed unless turned off 24 hours before the end of the period, and the account will be automatically charged for renewal as well. You may turn it off in your Account Settings anytime.
